title: OpenMerge repository configuration, version 1
description: Repository policy read from the default branch for every queue. See internal/config/README.md for YAML, grammar, and semantic validation details.
$comment: Apply after YAML alias/merge expansion and strict YAML validation. Formats openmerge-condition, openmerge-duration and openmerge-base are loader assertions: editors may ignore them. Patterns describe syntax; Go RE2/glob compilation, unique queue names, integer/duration overflow, and YAML limits remain loader checks. Branch overlaps are per-queue diagnostics when resolving concrete branches, not file errors. Run openmerge config validate before committing.

version.description: Configuration version. Only version 1 is supported.

queues.description: One or more queues with unique names. Each concrete base branch must match only one queue.

delete_head_branch.description: Delete eligible same-repository landed heads. When omitted, inherit the serve --delete-head-branch setting (true by default).

name.description: Nonempty queue name (must contain a non-whitespace character).

base.description: Branch name or whole-path glob. Omission selects the repository's default branch. * and ? stay within slash-separated segments; ** crosses slashes; **/ also matches zero segments; backslash escapes the next character. Overlapping matches pause only the affected queues.

enter_when.description: Conjunction required to enter and remain queued. Empty means true; exact-head trust is independently required.

merge_when.description: Conjunction evaluated on the tested commit. Must require a positive named check-success equality directly or through nested and groups; or/not/counts do not qualify. The loader also rejects expressions passing with missing or failed checks.

merge_method.description: Commit preparation method. Fast-forward tests the unchanged final head and dequeues diverged heads without rebasing; only a consecutive linear chain can batch.

check_timeout.description: Maximum check wait, measured from test-ref publication. Zero disables the timeout.

checks.description: Optional bounded retry policy for failed required checks.

retry_failed.description: Rerun failed required checks once before confirming failure.

batch.description: Serial batch formation. Failing batches are bisected in queue order.

max_size.description: Maximum PRs tested together. Fast-forward selects only a consecutive linear prefix.

max_wait.description: Wait for a partial fresh batch to fill; singleton mode and pending retry/bisection groups start immediately.

duration.description: Nonnegative Go time.ParseDuration string (signed 64-bit nanoseconds); integer zero also disables. Units: ns, us, µs, μs, ms, s, m, h. Fractions and composite durations are accepted. The loader checks range and sign, including negative zero.

conditions.description: Implicit AND of condition strings and logical groups. Quote strings beginning with # in YAML.

condition.description: Atom [-][#]attribute [operator value], or exactly one and/or/not group. Missing or mistyped observations stay unknown, including under negation.

oneOf.description: Strings/lists: =, !=, ~= (Go RE2), glob. List lengths (#): =, !=, <, <=, >, >= and a Go integer. Booleans draft/conflict: bare or =/!= true/false. Prefix - negates. Value is the trimmed remainder, with no inner quoting syntax.

and.description: All children must hold. Empty AND is true.

or.description: Any child must hold. Empty OR is false.

not.description: Negates one string or logical group; unknown remains unknown.

requiredCheck.description: A required positive success atom, possibly nested only through conjunctions.
